approval: The user approved one secondary Level 3 DD-versus-RR rich-taxonomy-guidance comparison before formal taxonomy-generalisation execution.
scope: Secondary Level 3 RR only. The primary NN/DN/ND/DD crossover and L1-D to L4-D difficulty curve remain unchanged.
authorship: Human-authored project taxonomy guidance created only from the twelve canonical aspect names, their parent-child hierarchy, and general language knowledge. No FABSA review text, corpus statistics, labels, predictions, confusion matrices, or error analysis were consulted.

template.sentiment_balance_rule: Aliases name a topic, channel, entity, or process rather than expressing praise or criticism. Definitions and boundaries must not favour one candidate sentiment.

allowed_sources: the twelve canonical FABSA aspect names
forbidden_sources: target validation or test F1 used to select aliases or boundaries
canonical_order: Purchase booking experience: Ease of use

Account management: Account access.definition: Accessing or regaining access to a customer account, including signing in, passwords, registration, verification, locked accounts, and account credentials.
Account management: Account access.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when the subject is obtaining, maintaining, or recovering access to a customer account or its credentials.
Account management: Account access.contrastive_boundary: A contact channel without an account-access issue belongs to Email or Phone; a digital-interface problem that is not about credentials belongs to App website.

Company brand: Competitor.definition: Another company, provider, brand, or alternative is named, compared, preferred, considered, or used as a substitute for the focal company.
Company brand: Competitor.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when another provider, brand, or substitute is part of a comparison, choice, preference, or switch.
Company brand: Competitor.contrastive_boundary: An overall judgement of the focal company without an alternative provider belongs to General satisfaction.

Company brand: General satisfaction.definition: An overall judgement of the company, service, or complete customer experience rather than a judgement limited to one operational feature.
Company brand: General satisfaction.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when the judgement concerns the company, service, or experience as a whole.
Company brand: General satisfaction.contrastive_boundary: A judgement limited to account access, speed, a digital channel, booking, staff, price, discounts, or reviews belongs to the corresponding specific aspect.

Company brand: Reviews.definition: Customer reviews, ratings, testimonials, reputation feedback, or the act of reading, leaving, requesting, or responding to a review.
Company brand: Reviews.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when reviews, ratings, testimonials, or review-management activity are themselves being discussed.
Company brand: Reviews.contrastive_boundary: A customer's opinion expressed inside a review is not by itself about Reviews unless reviews or ratings are discussed as an object.

Logistics rides: Speed.definition: How quickly or slowly a journey, ride, delivery, collection, or logistics service happens, including delays, waiting time, and punctuality.
Logistics rides: Speed.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when elapsed time, arrival timing, waiting, delay, or punctuality of a ride or logistics service is the subject.
Logistics rides: Speed.contrastive_boundary: Ease of completing a booking belongs to Ease of use, while the response time of an email or telephone interaction belongs to that support channel.

Online experience: App website.definition: Using the mobile app, website, webpage, online portal, or digital interface, including navigation, loading, crashes, bugs, and online functionality.
Online experience: App website.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when the digital channel, interface, navigation, loading, stability, or online functionality is the subject.
Online experience: App website.contrastive_boundary: Credential and sign-in access belongs to Account access, while difficulty completing the purchase or booking workflow belongs to Ease of use.

Purchase booking experience: Ease of use.definition: How easy, difficult, clear, or convenient it is to purchase, order, reserve, book, check out, or complete the customer transaction workflow.
Purchase booking experience: Ease of use.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when the subject is completing a purchase, order, reservation, booking, checkout, or related transaction workflow.
Purchase booking experience: Ease of use.contrastive_boundary: A general app or website functionality issue belongs to App website unless it specifically concerns completing the transaction workflow.

Staff support: Attitude of staff.definition: The behaviour, manner, helpfulness, friendliness, rudeness, professionalism, knowledge, or empathy of employees and support staff.
Staff support: Attitude of staff.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when the conduct, manner, knowledge, professionalism, or interpersonal behaviour of staff is judged.
Staff support: Attitude of staff.contrastive_boundary: A mention of Email or Phone as a contact channel is not by itself about staff attitude, although both aspects may apply when the person's conduct is also judged.

Staff support: Email.definition: Customer contact or support through email, including sending messages, replies, response time, missing responses, and the quality of an email exchange.
Staff support: Email.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when email is the communication channel or when sending, receiving, or awaiting an email response is discussed.
Staff support: Email.contrastive_boundary: Telephone contact belongs to Phone; a judgement about the staff member's manner may additionally belong to Attitude of staff.

Staff support: Phone.definition: Customer contact or support by telephone, including calls, call centres, being on hold, callbacks, answering, and telephone conversations.
Staff support: Phone.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when telephone contact, calling, answering, holding, or receiving a callback is discussed.
Staff support: Phone.contrastive_boundary: Email exchanges belong to Email; a judgement about the staff member's manner may additionally belong to Attitude of staff.

Value: Discounts promotions.definition: Discounts, promotions, promotional offers, coupons, vouchers, sales, special deals, loyalty offers, or advertised price reductions.
Value: Discounts promotions.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when a specific reduction, promotion, coupon, voucher, deal, sale, or loyalty offer is the subject.
Value: Discounts promotions.contrastive_boundary: An ordinary price, cost, fee, affordability, or value judgement without a specific promotional reduction belongs to Price value for money.

Value: Price value for money.definition: The ordinary price, cost, charge, fee, affordability, expensiveness, cheapness, or whether the service is worth what the customer paid.
Value: Price value for money.inclusion_boundary: Use this aspect when ordinary price, cost, fees, affordability, or the relationship between what was paid and what was received is judged.
Value: Price value for money.contrastive_boundary: A specific coupon, sale, promotional offer, voucher, or advertised reduction belongs to Discounts promotions.

hash_algorithm: sha256(canonical UTF-8 JSON; sorted keys; compact separators)
